parameters.content:
## AI Supplier Invoice Auditor (demo: Spice House restaurant, supplier City Foods Wholesale)
Staff uploads a supplier invoice PDF on a form - Groq extracts the line items, Code nodes check the maths and compare every price against the agreed price list, an AI agent writes a plain-language audit, and the workflow returns an HTML audit report document. No email/sheet step (no Google APIs on this VM). Digital PDFs only.

nodes.name: Upload Invoice
nodes.notes: POST a PDF here (multipart): restaurant_name + invoice_pdf.

parameters.inputSchema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"supplier": {"type": "string", "description": "Name of the supplier company"}, "invoiceNumber": {"type": "string", "description": "Invoice number as written"}, "invoiceDate": {"type": "string", "description": "Invoice date as written"}, "dueDate": {"type": "string", "description": "Payment due date as written"}, "lineItems": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"item": {"type": "string"}, "quantity": {"type": "number"}, "unit": {"type": "string"}, "unitPrice": {"type": "number"}, "lineTotal": {"type": "number"}}, "required": ["item", "quantity", "unitPrice", "lineTotal"]}}, "subtotal": {"type": "number"}, "tax": {"type": "number"}, "grandTotal": {"type": "number"}}, "required": ["supplier", "invoiceNumber", "lineItems", "subtotal", "grandTotal"]}

options.systemPromptTemplate: You are an invoice data extractor for a small restaurant. Read the supplier invoice text and extract the supplier name, invoice number, invoice date, due date, every line item (item name, quantity, unit, unit price, line total), subtotal, tax and grand total. Copy numbers exactly as written - never calculate or round them yourself.

nodes.name: Agreed Price List
nodes.notes: Agreed rates with City Foods Wholesale (per kg / per litre).

parameters.text: ={{ '<context>Spice House is a small restaurant. City Foods Wholesale sent invoice ' + $json.invoiceNumber + ' dated ' + $json.invoiceDate + '.</context><task>Write a plain-language audit summary for the restaurant owner.</task><input>Supplier: ' + $json.supplier + '. Invoice total: $' + $json.grandTotal + '. Verdict: ' + $json.verdict + '. Total overcharge found: $' + $json.totalOvercharge + '. Maths errors: ' + JSON.stringify($json.mathErrors) + '. Price flags: ' + JSON.stringify($json.priceFlags) + '.</input><format>3-5 short bullet lines, plain English, no jargon. Say what was overcharged and by how much, what to dispute with the supplier, and what to check next time.</format><rules>Use ONLY the numbers in the input. Never invent an item, a price, or a date. Under 120 words. Return only the summary text, no JSON, no markdown headings.</rules>' }}

options.systemMessage: You are an invoice auditor for a small restaurant. The owner wants a plain-language summary of what is wrong with a supplier invoice. Write 3-5 short bullet lines: what was overcharged and by how much, what to dispute with the supplier, and what to check next time. Use ONLY the facts and numbers given - never invent an item, a price, or a date. Under 120 words. Return only the summary text, no JSON, no markdown headings.

assignments.name: output
assignments.value: No issues found. Every line total matches quantity x unit price, the subtotal and grand total add up, and every item was billed at the agreed rate. Nothing to dispute on this invoice.
